The Dessert Witch has different stats and skills in its form.

- Dessert Witch
Uses .
Note that while is active, its SPD will increase.

- Dessert Witch (Apex Form)

It also has an ability that decreases the buff effects of Kioku.

- Dessert Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Uses .

The Artist Witch has different skills and stats in its form.

- Artist Witch
Uses .
Uses a barrier, and while the barrier is active, its ability will trigger multiple buffs and debuffs.

- Artist Witch (Apex Form)
Uses .
The boss enhances itself based on its Magic.
Be especially careful right after the start of battle when its Magic is high.

- Artist Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Critical rate decreases outside the Labyrinth Vanguard Activation Phase.
So be sure to use skills that increase critical rate and buffs gained during the Execution Phase to maintain as high a critical rate as possible.

The Darkness Witch has different skills and stats in its form.

- Darkness Witch
Uses .
Using special attacks will advance the boss' action order.

- Darkness Witch (Apex Form)
The boss enhances itself based of how few debuffs are applied to it.
Defeating it with few debuffs applied to it will be difficult, so be sure to assign Kioku capable of applying debuffs to your party.

- Darkness Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Uses .
DMG decreases with fewer allies in break.
Time your special attacks to when multiple enemies are in break to deal damage efficiently.

The Dog Witch has different skills and stats in its form.

- Dog Witch
Uses .
Try interrupting the boss by putting it into break or dealing heavy damage.

- Dog Witch (Apex Form)
Its Magic decreases based on the number of allies that take critical DMG.
The damage and effects of some skills decrease as its Magic decreases, so try assigning Kioku to your party capable of increasing critical rate and performing all-target attacks.

- Dog Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Uses .
During the countdown, it uses counterattacks based on the number of passing enemy turns, so try interrupting the boss by putting it into break or by swiftly dealing heavy damage.

The Box Witch has different stats and skills in its form.

- Box Witch
When attacked by an enemy with less than 20% HP, restores a small amount of HP and advances action order.

- Box Witch (Apex Form)
Decreases all enemies' ATK, DEF, and SPD each time Magic reaches max.
Its Magic increases when attacked by an enemy with less than 30% HP, so be sure to assign Kioku capable of restoring HP to your party.

- Box Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Uses .
When attacked by an enemy with less than 40% HP, guaranteed to decrease all enemies' SPD.
Its SPD also increases when an enemy with a debuff is present, so try not to attack the Box Witch with Kioku who have low HP.

In Wave 2, only the Witch appears.
The Silver Witch has different stats and skills in its form.

- Silver Witch
On enemy actions when it does not take damage, it accumulates Magic, and a counterattack triggers each time its Magic reaches max.
Be careful, because if you are hit by a counterattack when the Witch has no debuffs, it will delay your action order.

- Silver Witch (Apex Form)
While it has a barrier active, its SPD and break gauge depletion RES increases.
It receives a barrier every set number of turns, so be ready to remove the buff or break it with Attackers.

- Silver Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Uses .
When its Magic reaches 0, its break gauge depletion RES decreases.
The Witch's Magic decreases each time a debuff is applied while the countdown is active or it is in break.
Once the countdown starts, be ready to quickly apply debuffs to drain the Witch's Magic.

The Rose Garden Witch has different stats and skills in its form.

- Rose Garden Witch
Each time a certain number of enemy turns pass, uses a counterattack.
On each counterattack, the Witch's ATK and SPD increases.

- Rose Garden Witch (Apex Form)
Increases DMG and effects of some of its skills based on Magic value.
The Witch's Magic decreases based on the number of allies attacked simultaneously by battle skills.

- Rose Garden Witch (Apex Overdrive Form)
Uses .
The Witch slightly decreases all enemies' MP after a certain number of enemy turns pass, so be mindful of when to use your special attacks.
